title: Grey Talon: Charged Shot during Rain of Arrows T3 (30% airborne spirit lifesteal)
question: Does an arrow fired while airborne in Rain of Arrows T3 heal for ~30% of its damage, making rival order O5 (Rain maxed before Owl: Rain T3 @13.8k instead of 26.9k) a sustain engine?
hypothesis: Heal in R3 >= 25% of arrow damage in the block; R2 and G heal < 5%. Timeline: at 13.8k an arrow does ~365, so ~110 HP per airborne arrow, ~220-330 per Rain cast (cd 13s at T2).
controls: hardreset + abil per block, abilist logged
lowhp 50 so heals are not capped
procedure: read healsum/healDiffObserved per block and arrow damage per mark

decision.rule: SUPPORTED if R3 - max(R2,G) >= 20 points in >=4/5 runs (then O5 becomes a candidate second playstyle, still UNTESTABLE-HIGH-RISK for aiming while gliding); REFUTED if R3 within 5 points of R2; else INCONCLUSIVE. Caveat: hold/cast sequencing may land before the arrow fires: check the arrow hit happened while airborne (samples z).

verdict_use: inconclusive until run; current order kept
